The '''tintolive tree''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of spirate-leaved<ref name="Rebirth" /> [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Multiple square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of tintolive [[Forest/Legends|forest]] grew on the foothills located in Chandrila's [[Gladean State Parks]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', which includes [[Kyp Durron]]'s search for [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] attempted to avoid fellow Jedi [[Kyp Durron]] because she believed that Durron would ask her to be his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]]. Ultimately, Durron was able to find Solo, a fact that the latter ascertained when she saw Durron through the leaves of a group of tintolive trees on a Chandrilan hillside.<ref name="Rebirth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tintolive trees first appeared in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second volume of the ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'', which was itself a part of the series ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''.<ref name="Rebirth" />
